item.title: Email Marketing for Small Businesses: Getting Started
item.description: Email marketing might seem like a daunting venture for small business owners just starting. However, it's more akin to planting a garden - with the right tools and knowledge, you'll soon see your efforts bloom into something beautiful and rewarding. Let's dive deep into understanding why email marketing is essential, uncover its benefits specifically for small businesses, and set some realistic expectations for beginners.
